headline: A fictional platform grows while investment rises
deck: Example data only: a two-panel chart story illustrates operating growth and investment.
alt_text: Fictional example. Cloud growth increases from 40 to 60 percent while Search growth falls from 15 to 10 percent. Quarterly capex rises from 8 to 18 billion while operating cash flow moves from 20 to 17 billion.

panels.title: Cloud accelerates as Search growth slows
